verdict.rationale: The Washington Secretary of State runs online business filing and registry services. Such a service could plausibly offer event subscriptions (for example, filing-status or entity-change notifications), so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions webhooks, registrable callbacks, or any programmatic event subscription. The pack covers only web forms, online filing, search, live chat, and in-person service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
